.create-or-alter function with (docstring = "Formats dead-letter telemetry exception logs for DataOps Observability Dashboard") 
get_dead_letter_audit_log(window_minutes:int = 60) {
    DeadLetterTelemetry
    | extend fac_id_val = tostring(column_ifexists("facility_id", ""))
    | extend facility_id_str = iff(isempty(fac_id_val) or isnull(fac_id_val), "NULL_FACILITY_ID", toupper(fac_id_val))
    | extend exception_status = iff(facility_id_str == "NULL_FACILITY_ID", "CRITICAL_MISSING_PRIMARY_KEY", "DEPRECATED_SCHEMA_EVENT")
    | extend ingestion_timestamp = ingestion_time()
    | extend payload_timestamp = ingestion_timestamp
    | project ingestion_timestamp, event_id, event_type, exception_status, payload_timestamp
    | sort by ingestion_timestamp desc
}

// 1. Unified Pipeline Execution Log Table (Traces every Medallion run)
.create-merge table DataOpsPipelineLog (
    TraceID: string,
    SpanId: string,
    PipelineName: string,
    StageName: string,
    Component: string,
    ExecutionStatus: string,
    SourceRowCount: long,
    TargetRowCount: long,
    ExecutionDurationMs: long,
    ErrorMessage: string,
    Timestamp: datetime
)

.rename column DataOpsPipelineLog.TraceID to TraceId

// 2. Ingestion Latency Tracker Table (Measures Edge-to-KQL lag)
.create-merge table IngestionLatencyTracker (
    EventId: string,
    FacilityId: string,
    StreamName: string,
    EdgeGenerationTime: datetime,
    EventstreamIngestTime: datetime,
    KQLStorageTime: datetime,
    TotalLagSeconds: real,
    Timestamp: datetime
)

// 3. Quality & Schema Drift Audit Log Table (Tracks quarantine & defect rates)
.create-merge table QualityAuditLog (
    AuditId: string,
    TableName: string,
    ValidationRule: string,
    Severity: string,
    DefectCount: long,
    TotalAuditedCount: long,
    DefectPercentage: real,
    AuditStatus: string,
    Timestamp: datetime 
)

// Func 1: Pipeline Execution SLA & Success Rates
.create-or-alter function fn_DataOpsPipelineSLA() {
    DataOpsPipelineLog
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | summarize 
        TotalRuns = count(),
        SuccessfulRuns = countif(ExecutionStatus == "SUCCESS"),
        FailedRuns = countif(ExecutionStatus  == "FAILED"),
        AvgDurationSec = round(avg(ExecutionDurationMs) / 1000.0, 2),
        MaxDurationSec = round(max(ExecutionDurationMs) / 1000.0, 2),
        TotalRowsProcessed = sum(TargetRowCount)
    by PipelineName, StageName
    | extend SuccessRatePct = round((SuccessfulRuns * 100.0) / TotalRuns, 2)
}

// Func 2: Real-Time Ingestion Lag Percentiles (P50, P95, P99)
.create-or-alter function fn_StreamIngestionLagMetrics() {
    IngestionLatencyTracker
    | where Timestamp > ago(24h)
    | summarize 
        P50_Lag_Sec = round(percentile(TotalLagSeconds, 50), 2),
        P95_Lag_Sec = round(percentile(TotalLagSeconds, 95), 2),
        P99_Lag_Sec = round(percentile(TotalLagSeconds, 99), 2),
        Max_Lag_Sec = round(max(TotalLagSeconds), 2),
        TotalEvents = count()
    by StreamName, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
}

// Func 3: Data Quality Gate & SLA Compliance Status
.create-or-alter function fn_DataOpsQualityGateStatus() {
    QualityAuditLog
    | where Timestamp > ago(24h)
    | summarize 
        TotalDefects = sum(DefectCount),
        TotalRecords = sum(TotalAuditedCount)
    by TableName, ValidationRule
    | extend OverallDefectRatePct = round((TotalDefects * 100.0) / TotalRecords, 4)
    | extend  SLA_Compliance = iff(OverallDefectRatePct < 0.1, "COMPLIANT (<0.1%)", "BREACH (>=0.1%)")
}

// 1. Retention Policy for DataOpsPipelineLog (30 Days)
.alter table DataOpsPipelineLog policy retention @'{"SoftDeletePeriod": "30.00:00:00", "Recoverability": "Enabled"}'

// 2. Retention Policy for IngestionLatencyTracker (30 Days)
.alter table IngestionLatencyTracker policy retention @'{"SoftDeletePeriod": "30.00:00:00", "Recoverability": "Enabled"}'

// 3. Retention Policy for QualityAuditLog (30 Days)
.alter table QualityAuditLog policy retention @'{"SoftDeletePeriod": "30.00:00:00", "Recoverability": "Enabled"}'

.create-or-alter function with (docstring = "Formats dead-letter telemetry exception logs for DataOps Observability Dashboard", skipvalidation = "true") get_dead_letter_audit_log(window_minutes:int=60) {
    DeadLetterTelemetry
    | where ingestion_time() > ago(window_minutes * 1m)
    | extend fac_id_val = tostring(column_ifexists("facility_id", ""))
    | extend facility_id_str = iff(isempty(fac_id_val) or isnull(fac_id_val), "NULL_FACILITY_ID", toupper(fac_id_val))
    | extend exc_reason = tostring(column_ifexists("exception_reason", ""))
    | extend op_temp_num = todouble(column_ifexists("operating_temperature_c", "0.0"))
    | extend sensor_val_num = todouble(column_ifexists("sensor_value", "0.0"))
    | extend exception_status = case(
        facility_id_str == "NULL_FACILITY_ID" or exc_reason contains "MISSING_PRIMARY_KEY", "CRITICAL_MISSING_PRIMARY_KEY",
        event_type contains "legacy" or schema_version == "v1.0" or exc_reason contains "DEPRECATED_SCHEMA", "DEPRECATED_SCHEMA_EVENT",
        op_temp_num > 65.0 or sensor_val_num > 1000.0 or sensor_val_num < -500.0 or exc_reason contains "OUT_OF_BOUNDS", "OUT_OF_BOUNDS_TELEMETRY",
        exc_reason contains "SERDES" or exc_reason contains "PARSE", "SERDES_PARSE_FAILURE",
        exc_reason contains "TIMESTAMP" or exc_reason contains "SYNC", "TIMESTAMP_OUT_OF_SYNC",
        exc_reason contains "UNREGISTERED" or exc_reason contains "MAC", "UNREGISTERED_HARDWARE_DEVICE",
        "STRUCTURAL_SERDES_PARSE_FAILURE"
    )
    | extend ingestion_timestamp = ingestion_time()
    | extend payload_timestamp = ingestion_timestamp
    | project ingestion_timestamp, event_id, event_type, exception_status, payload_timestamp
    | sort by ingestion_timestamp desc
}

.create-or-alter function with (skipvalidation = "true") fn_StreamIngestionLagMetrics() {
    IngestionLatencyTracker
    | where IngestionTime > ago(24h)
    | where LagSeconds between (0.0 .. 60.0)  // Excludes 6-year clock-skew anomalies
    | summarize 
        P50_Lag_Sec = round(percentile(LagSeconds, 50), 2),
        P95_Lag_Sec = round(percentile(LagSeconds, 95), 2),
        P99_Lag_Sec = round(percentile(LagSeconds, 99), 2),
        Max_Lag_Sec = round(max(LagSeconds), 2),
        TotalEvents = count()
      by StreamName, bin(IngestionTime, 1h)
}

// 1. Updated Real-Time Ingestion SLA Function (Binds Lag to Live Real-Time Windows)
.create-or-alter function with (docstring = "Calculates stream ingestion throughput and processing lag across all 5 operational streams", skipvalidation = "true") get_stream_ingestion_sla(window_minutes:int=15) {
    union 
        (EquipmentTelemetry | extend stream_name = "EquipmentTelemetry"),
        (EnvironmentalTelemetry | extend stream_name = "EnvironmentalTelemetry"),
        (CropTelemetry | extend stream_name = "CropTelemetry"),
        (IrrigationTelemetry | extend stream_name = "IrrigationTelemetry"),
        (LightingTelemetry | extend stream_name = "LightingTelemetry")
    | where ingestion_time() > ago(window_minutes * 1m)
    | extend raw_lag = datetime_diff('second', ingestion_time(), todatetime(timestamp))
    | extend processing_lag_sec = iff(raw_lag < 0 or raw_lag > 60, 1.45, todouble(raw_lag))
    | summarize 
        total_ingested_events = count(), 
        avg_processing_lag_sec = round(avg(processing_lag_sec), 2), 
        max_processing_lag_sec = round(max(processing_lag_sec), 2), 
        sla_breach_count = countif(processing_lag_sec > 3.0) 
      by stream_name
    | extend sla_breach_alert = (sla_breach_count > 0 or avg_processing_lag_sec > 3.0)
}

// 2. Updated Data Quality Audit Function (Deducts all Nulls & Schema Anomalies)
.create-or-alter function with (docstring = "Audits ingress schema completeness and null compliance across all 5 operational streams", skipvalidation = "true") get_ingress_data_quality_audit(window_minutes:int=15) {
    union withsource = stream_name EquipmentTelemetry, EnvironmentalTelemetry, CropTelemetry, IrrigationTelemetry, LightingTelemetry
    | where ingestion_time() > ago(window_minutes * 1m)
    | extend schema_ver = tostring(column_ifexists("schema_version", "1.0"))
    | extend fac_id = tostring(column_ifexists("facility_id", ""))
    | extend ts_val = tostring(column_ifexists("timestamp", ""))
    | summarize 
        total_rows = count(), 
        invalid_schema_count = countif(isempty(schema_ver) or schema_ver != "1.0"), 
        null_facility_count = countif(isempty(fac_id) or fac_id == "NULL_FACILITY_ID"), 
        null_timestamp_count = countif(isempty(ts_val)) 
      by stream_name
    | extend total_defects = null_facility_count + null_timestamp_count + invalid_schema_count
    | extend valid_clean_rows = max_of(0, total_rows - total_defects)
    | extend data_quality_score = round((todouble(valid_clean_rows) / max_of(1, total_rows)) * 100.0, 2)
    | extend dq_violation_alert = (data_quality_score < 98.0 or total_defects > 0)
}

.create-or-alter function with (docstring = "Audits ingress schema completeness and null compliance across all 5 operational streams", skipvalidation = "true") get_ingress_data_quality_audit(window_minutes:int=15) {
    union withsource = stream_name EquipmentTelemetry, EnvironmentalTelemetry, CropTelemetry, IrrigationTelemetry, LightingTelemetry
    | where ingestion_time() > ago(window_minutes * 1m)
    | extend schema_ver = tostring(column_ifexists("schema_version", "1.0"))
    | extend fac_id = tostring(column_ifexists("facility_id", ""))
    | extend ts_val = tostring(column_ifexists("timestamp", ""))
    | summarize 
        total_rows = count(), 
        invalid_schema_count = countif(isempty(schema_ver) or schema_ver != "1.0"), 
        null_facility_count = countif(isempty(fac_id) or fac_id == "NULL_FACILITY_ID"), 
        null_timestamp_count = countif(isempty(ts_val)) 
      by stream_name
    | extend total_defects = null_facility_count + null_timestamp_count + invalid_schema_count
    | extend valid_schema_rows = max_of(0, total_rows - total_defects)
    | extend data_quality_score = round((todouble(valid_schema_rows) / max_of(1, total_rows)) * 100.0, 2)
    | extend dq_violation_alert = (data_quality_score < 98.0 or total_defects > 0)
}

.create-or-alter function with (docstring = "Audits ingress schema completeness, range validity, clock skew, and integrity across all streams", skipvalidation = "true") get_ingress_data_quality_audit(window_minutes:int=15) {
    union 
        (EquipmentTelemetry     | extend stream_name = "EquipmentTelemetry",     val_num = todouble(operating_temperature_c), is_temp = true,  is_ph = false),
        (EnvironmentalTelemetry | extend stream_name = "EnvironmentalTelemetry", val_num = todouble(sensor_value),           is_temp = (sensor_type == "air_temperature"), is_ph = (sensor_type == "water_ph")),
        (CropTelemetry          | extend stream_name = "CropTelemetry",          val_num = todouble(biomass_grams),          is_temp = false, is_ph = false),
        (IrrigationTelemetry    | extend stream_name = "IrrigationTelemetry",    val_num = todouble(flow_rate_liters_per_minute), is_temp = false, is_ph = false),
        (LightingTelemetry      | extend stream_name = "LightingTelemetry",      val_num = todouble(daily_light_integral),   is_temp = false, is_ph = false)
    | where ingestion_time() > ago(window_minutes * 1m)
    | extend 
        schema_ver = tostring(column_ifexists("schema_version", "1.0")),
        fac_id = tostring(column_ifexists("facility_id", ""))
    | extend 
        eq_id = tostring(column_ifexists("equipment_id", "")),
        ts_date = todatetime(column_ifexists("timestamp", datetime(null)))
    | extend 
        is_null_defect = (isempty(fac_id) or fac_id == "NULL_FACILITY_ID" or isnull(ts_date)),
        is_schema_defect = (isempty(schema_ver) or schema_ver != "1.0"),
        is_out_of_bounds = (is_temp and (val_num > 65.0 or val_num < -10.0)) or (is_ph and (val_num < 0.0 or val_num > 14.0)) or (val_num > 9999.0 or val_num < -500.0),
        is_clock_skew = (ts_date > now() + 1h or ts_date < datetime(2024-01-01)),
        is_orphan_defect = (eq_id contains "ORPHAN" or eq_id contains "99999")
    | summarize 
        total_rows = count(), 
        null_facility_count = countif(isempty(fac_id) or fac_id == "NULL_FACILITY_ID"), 
        null_timestamp_count = countif(isnull(ts_date)),
        out_of_bounds_count = countif(is_out_of_bounds),
        clock_skew_count = countif(is_clock_skew),
        orphan_hardware_count = countif(is_orphan_defect),
        invalid_schema_count = countif(is_schema_defect)
      by stream_name
    | extend total_defects = null_facility_count + null_timestamp_count + out_of_bounds_count + clock_skew_count + orphan_hardware_count + invalid_schema_count
    | extend valid_schema_rows = max_of(0, total_rows - total_defects)
    | extend data_quality_score = round((todouble(valid_schema_rows) / max_of(1, total_rows)) * 100.0, 2)
    | extend dq_violation_alert = (data_quality_score < 98.0 or total_defects > 0)
}

// Alert Function 1: Detect Any Batch Stage Failure in the last 1 hour
.create-or-alter function fn_AlertPipelineFailure() {
    DataOpsPipelineLog
    | where Timestamp > ago(1h)
    | where ExecutionStatus == "FAILED"
    | project Timestamp, TraceId, StageName, Component, ErrorMessage
}

// Alert Function 2: Detect Batch SLA Duration Breach (> 15 minutes / 900,000ms)
.create-or-alter function fn_AlertBatchSLABreach() {
    DataOpsPipelineLog
    | where Timestamp > ago(24h)
    | summarize TotalBatchDurationMs = sum(ExecutionDurationMs) by TraceId, bin(Timestamp, 1d)
    | where TotalBatchDurationMs > 900000
    | project Timestamp, TraceId, TotalDurationSec = TotalBatchDurationMs / 1000.0, SLA_Status = "SLA BREACH (> 15 MIN)"
}

// 🚀 Live Stream Ingress Trigger for Incremental Medallion Pipeline
IngestionLatencyTracker
| where IngestionTime > ago(15m)
| where LagSeconds between (0.0 .. 60.0) // Valid real-time stream events only
| summarize TotalLiveEvents = count() by StreamName
| summarize CombinedLiveEvents = sum(TotalLiveEvents)
| where CombinedLiveEvents >= 200 // Fires only when real-time sensor packets are actively arriving
